chapter: Back to Los Angeles and joining Basie
title: Pay: two dollars a night at the Reno, thirty-three dollars at the Savoy
summary: After good pay in Shanghai he earned two dollars a night in Kansas City and $33 a week at the Savoy.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Getting paid: wages, scale and the pay envelope

blocks.x: But see, in the Reno Club we worked from ten o'clock at night until four o'clock in the morning. Out of all the salaries I made, I made a nice salary in Shanghai and I had been making some pretty nice salaries. I got to Kansas City, they paid me from ten o'clock to four o'clock in the morning, I got two dollars a night, fourteen dollars a week.
(LAUGHTER). I mean that really was awful.

I tell you, I came from China where I was making more; the guys in the band were making a hundred. And then to end up with Basie. But one thing, the only reason I did stay was because I knew he was going to get out of it. He was going to go to New York. But it didn't get much better.
We got to New York, we went to the Savoy Ballroom for thirty-three dollars a week.
Well that was scale about then wasn't it?
Thirty-three, yes. But shoot, they paid much better out on the West Coast. Then he eventually went on up and with the recordings and ......
